chapters.title: The founding
chapters.text:
Niilá, Minmantė, Kaunikki, Leofgifu, Leofburh, Hallrik Eiriksson, Áilu, Mingirdė, Arnhild Bjarnardóttir and Mieli arrived together in summer.

The founding party had two adult does and one adult buck and 1 longship.

Leofgifu and Hallrik Eiriksson were already partners. Their first households lived in tents.

Niilá, Minmantė, Kaunikki and Leofburh worked as farmers. Leofgifu worked as a fisher. Hallrik Eiriksson, Mingirdė, Arnhild Bjarnardóttir and Mieli worked as hunters. Áilu worked as a woodworker.
